strings.name: Robert Lewandowski
strings.summary: Lewandowski rose from Poland's lower divisions to become a leading European striker through movement, link play and two-footed finishing. He won German titles with Dortmund, then a Champions League treble with Bayern, receiving FIFA's men's player award in 2020 and 2021. His 41 Bundesliga goals in 2020–21 set a season record. After Barcelona, he joined Chicago Fire in 2026 while continuing with Poland.

strings.highlights.h2.text: Won The Best FIFA Men's Player in 2020 and 2021.
